HexKagune 1.3.8 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 57, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- Eto's Owl kakuja, her last resort: below a quarter of her health she grows the Owl, the flesh bursting out of her into the whole creature, drawn in her place exactly like a player's Owl (the same model, growth, burst effects and animations), full size.
- In the Owl she takes half damage from every hit.
- Its Rend: the four cuts of the giant blades, chained, the last one its jaws, knocking you down.
- Its Reaping Whirl: a whole turn with both giant arms out, when more than one thing is on her (or now and then).
- Its Pounce: from mid range, the bound and both blades driven into the ground as she lands, with a shockwave.
- Out of the fight for six seconds, she sheds it; it comes back a minute after that. Her Mutated Arm and tentacles go back in when she grows it.
- Not yet on her: the Owl's Big Punch, Speed Kick, bone spikes, Fissure, blade volley, Watch This lances and great hand (players' Owl only).
- Players who come into view see her already in it; it goes away if she dies.
